cause: Revision storage retained deterministic createdTick but had no authoritative human timestamp or creator provenance required by DOC-C history responses.
violation: DOC-C §4.2 artifact history requires created_at + created_by; DOC-C storage skeleton carries createdAt/createdBy.
impact: Canonical revision history could not be emitted without guessing timestamp or actor.
fix: Persist Revision.createdAt and createdBy; require caller-provided provenance; migration aborts if legacy rows exist rather than fabricating backfill.
prevention: Migration round-trip gate, module-boundary gate, provenance integration tests and explicit caller-owned timestamp semantics.
